summary: Frontend-only regression for /onboarding wizard bug fixes. Verified: (1) sustain typing char-by-char on ob-full_name, ob-phone, ob-city (step 0) and ob-height_cm, ob-weight_kg (step 1) — focus retained and each character persisted (activeElement testid unchanged). (2) 'Kembali' button behaves correctly: from step 1 it returns to step 0 with previously typed data intact ('BudiSantoso' / '08123456789' / 'Jakarta'); from step 0 it navigates back out of /onboarding (to /login). (3) Registration -> auto-redirect to /onboarding works. (4) Mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow, Back/Lanjut buttons visible. (5) Select dropdowns (gender, goal, training_experience, training_days, equipment, meals_per_day) work and completeness % increases (54% -> 63% after step 2). HOWEVER a critical regression discovered: full 7-step flow cannot be completed — 'Selesai & Mulai' returns HTTP 400 because backend REQUIRED_ONBOARDING requires 'activity_level' which is NOT collected anywhere in the wizard. Completeness caps at 90% (10/11) so /api/onboarding/complete fails with 'Lengkapi data wajib terlebih dahulu (90%)'.

critical.issue: Rejects with 400 'Lengkapi data wajib terlebih dahulu (90%)' because REQUIRED_ONBOARDING (server.py:717) includes 'activity_level' which the wizard never asks. Completeness maxes at 10/11=90%. No user can finish onboarding. Also note: REQUIRED_ONBOARDING does NOT include 'training_experience', 'phone', 'city' which the wizard prompts. Frontend/backend field contract is out of sync.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend collects training_experience but backend expects activity_level. 'Selesai & Mulai' always fails with 400. Full onboarding flow blocked.

action_items: FIX field contract mismatch in /app/frontend/src/pages/Onboarding.jsx step 3: rename 'training_experience' -> 'activity_level' (or add a dedicated activity_level select) so backend REQUIRED_ONBOARDING list is satisfied. Alternatively update backend REQUIRED_ONBOARDING in /app/backend/server.py:717 to match what the wizard actually asks: replace 'activity_level' with 'training_experience' (and consider adding phone/city if desired). Retest full 7-step finish flow.
Consider adding a data-testid on the completeness span for stable assertions.

rca of the issue: Frontend wizard collects 'training_experience' (step 3) but backend REQUIRED_ONBOARDING in server.py:717 requires 'activity_level'. calc_completeness therefore counts 10/11 filled = 90%, and /api/onboarding/complete raises HTTPException(400) when completeness < 100. Reproduction: register new client, fill all 7 wizard steps, tick consent, click Selesai & Mulai -> POST /api/onboarding/complete returns 400. Mitigation: align field name between FE and BE (recommend renaming 'training_experience' -> 'activity_level' in Onboarding.jsx step 3, since 'activity_level' better reflects the field semantics used by other parts of a coaching backend).
